answer: Divergent-Nonce Challenge: each identity must periodically submit a fresh nonce derived from its own private state, signed under a unique quill. Clones share state, so they emit identical nonces and are flagged as one lineage, forcing real divergence. Every clone then needs independent entropy, costing a full key rotation plus a fresh quantum draw per identity, a gale of overhead that scales linearly. Failed divergence drops the identity behind a jetty: rate-limited and unranked until re-provisioned.
